description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableSet class, a persistent set implementation in Orleans that uses journaling to maintain unique collections across grain activations and restarts. The tests cover basic set operations, persistence, handling of complex types, enumeration, large datasets, set operations, and removal of multiple items.

classes.name: DurableSetTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality and correctness of the DurableSet implementation in Orleans, including operations like add, remove, persistence, enumeration, and set algebra.

methods.name: DurableSet_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic add, remove, and duplicate prevention operations of DurableSet.

methods.name: DurableSet_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the DurableSet correctly persists and recovers its state.

methods.name: DurableSet_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Checks handling of complex value types with proper equality semantics.

methods.name: DurableSet_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the clear operation on the DurableSet.

methods.name: DurableSet_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Verifies enumeration and conversion capabilities of the DurableSet.

methods.name: DurableSet_LargeNumberOfItems_Test
methods.description: Stress test for handling large datasets and recovery.

methods.name: DurableSet_SetOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests set algebra operations like intersection, union, and difference.

methods.name: DurableSet_ExceptWith_Test
methods.description: Tests removal of multiple items and set difference.
